connectors.description: List of connector URLs to use. See --connector.

password.description: Authentication password for the YubiHSM. See --password.

object_id.description: Object ID for commands that operate on specific objects. See --object-id.

domains.description: List of domains the object belongs to. See --domains.

capabilities.description: Capabilities bitmask for the object. See --capabilities.

object_type.description: Type of object to interact with. See --object-type.

ykhsmauth_label.description: Credential label on YubiKey for YKHSMAuth mode. See --ykhsmauth-label.

ykhsmauth_reader.description: Filter YubiKey reader name for YKHSMAuth. See --ykhsmauth-reader.

cacert.description: Path to CA certificate for HTTPS connector authentication. See --cacert.

cert.description: Path to HTTPS client certificate. See --cert.

key.description: Path to HTTPS client certificate key. See --key.

proxy.description: Proxy server URL for connector communication. See --proxy.

noproxy.description: List of hosts to bypass proxy for. See --noproxy.
